command_handler_probe.method: Independent adjacent-NOP code search and little-endian handler-prefix references. Contained candidates are treated as interior positions, not separate tables. Compared code intervals stop at next known handler or 256 bytes. This does not verify dispatcher use, complete function boundaries, helper/native callees, or runtime state.
